description: The popover under the header's chain-link button: this chat's two Signal switches, each a title and a small grey explanation with a switch at the right, 310 px wide.

parts.name: Show links
parts.shows: Title "Show links", caption "Draw the names Signal knows as links: files, code, commits, routes, Kubernetes objects, tools", a switch. On by default for a new chat.
text: Draw the names Signal knows as links: files, code, commits, routes, Kubernetes objects, tools

actions.does: Draws or stops drawing the names Signal knows in Claude's replies as links (alone: from what the folder's glossary, the catalogue and git already know, with no model). The reply views are relinked at once

parts.name: Activate Signal
parts.shows: Title "Activate Signal", caption "Look up the names in this chat's replies as they come, and let the reader (a model session) read the chat", a switch. Off by default for a new chat.
text: Look up the names in this chat's replies as they come, and let the reader (a model session) read the chat

actions.does: On: Signal runs for the chat's folder, looking up names as replies arrive and filling the glossary; toast "Signal is on for this chat: the names in its replies are looked up" (" and become links" when links are on) with a Show button that opens the side panel's Signal page. Off: toast "Signal stopped looking things up" (naming what stopped) "; its links stay", or "Signal is off: stopped …" if no window shows the chat

states.name: per chat
states.shows: Each chat keeps its own two switches (the last 500 chats); a new chat starts with links shown and Signal off, and what is set before the chat has an id is kept once it has one

states.name: no folder
states.shows: With no folder known, Signal is off whatever the switches say
